    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem

mh = Chem.MolFromXYZFile("tunicamycin_xtb.xyz")
pos = mh.GetConformer().GetPositions()

def side_signs(ring_idx, sub_pairs, name):
    P = pos[ring_idx]
    centroid = P.mean(0)
    # plane via SVD
    U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-centroid)
    n = Vt[2]
    print(f"--- {name} ---")
    for label, cidx, sidx in sub_pairs:
        v = pos[sidx]-pos[cidx]
        s = np.dot(v, n)
        print(f"  {label}: {'up' if s>0 else 'down'}  ({s:+.2f})")
    return n
